records.title: Divisional areas and staff locations: second part with explicit geographical alternatives
records.meaning: The stream reports a reached area and then lists areas and divisional staff locations. The proposed fills make SZENTES, HODMEZOE, ERREICHT, RAUM and MEZOEKOVACSHAZA legible. The precise unit designations, the relationship between the listed places and the garbled labels remain uncertain. The separate geographical alternative below proposes place-name spellings at an additional observed-coordinate cost; it is not independent historical confirmation.
records.reading_note: All 300 printed positions are retained. Four consecutive five-dash groups and the initial dash of -XFAF contribute 21 source masks. The primary reading uses 13 explicitly proposed mask fills and no change to an observed coordinate. Its eight unresolved plaintext positions and the known labels ?YDI D, ? K?38, 2R D, 6U, VASARHEY4, VASARTEL4, OROSHUZ?, NAG4BANHEG4ES and BATTRE4A are retained. In particular, the digit 4 is not silently read as Y. The source defines this as part 2 of 3; no missing first-part groups or third-part length are supplied. Date heading November 22 and reception November 23 remain separate evidence layers.
